summary.name: Grok (xAI)
summary.one_liner: x.ai is the homepage for xAI's Grok AI models, offering a chatbot and a unified API for text, code, voice, images, and video.
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes Grok, xAI's AI model family, covering reasoning, code, voice, images, and video. It shows a chat interface answering questions and a coding-agent demo that reads files and edits code. For developers, it describes a single unified API for text, code, voice, images, and video, with usage-based pricing and automatically increasing rate limits. An enterprise tier offers custom rate limits, dedicated onboarding, monthly invoicing, SSO, audit logging, and data residency options. The page cites figures such as 1M+ API calls per day and under 200ms median latency, though these are self-reported.
notable: Unified API covering text, code, voice, images, and video
Access to all Grok models with usage-based pricing
Enterprise options: SSO, audit logging, data residency
Coding agent demo that reads and edits project files
caveats: Usage-based API pricing; exact prices are not listed on the page
Enterprise features such as custom rate limits and monthly invoices require contacting the team
Performance figures are self-reported marketing claims
